title: 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.17625v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For video generation in dynamic world modeling, observed static and dynamic content should be efficiently reused to provide conditions for repeated generation at different times and viewpoints. We introduce 4LC, a 4D latent cache with composite visual representations and a flexible spatiotemporal access interface. As a latent cache, 4LC directly reuses visual representations of static and dynamic content to provide generation conditions, avoiding per-request RGB rendering and re-encoding. As a composite cache, 4LC binds visual representations from multiple visual encoders (e.g., VAE, DINO, V-JEPA, VGGT) to shared geometry and motion, allowing the composite representations to describe the dynamic world with rich information. Besides, we design a flexible spatiotemporal interface, which directly reads the cache at independently specified times and viewpoints and combines readouts across observations, providing a common conditioning forma

translated_title: 4LC：用于动态世界建模中高效条件生成的4D潜在缓存
translated_abstract: 在动态世界建模的视频生成中，观测到的静态和动态内容应被高效复用，以便在不同时间和视角下为重复生成提供条件。我们提出了4LC，一种具有复合视觉表示和灵活时空访问接口的4D潜在缓存。作为潜在缓存，4LC直接复用静态和动态内容的视觉表示以提供生成条件，避免了针对每个请求的RGB渲染和重新编码。作为复合缓存，4LC将来自多个视觉编码器（如VAE、DINO、V-JEPA、VGGT）的视觉表示绑定到共享的几何和运动信息上，使复合表示能够以丰富的信息描述动态世界。此外，我们设计了灵活的时空接口，可直接在独立指定的时间和视角读取缓存，并组合跨观测的读取结果，提供了统一的条件格式。
tldr: 4LC提出了一种4D潜在缓存方法，通过复用多编码器绑定的复合视觉表示和灵活的时空访问接口，高效地为动态世界建模中任意时间和视角的视频生成提供条件，避免了重复的RGB渲染与再编码。
en_tdlr: 4LC introduces a 4D latent cache that reuses composite visual representations from multiple encoders with a flexible spatiotemporal interface, enabling efficient conditioning for video generation at arbitrary times and viewpoints in dynamic world modeling while avoiding redundant RGB rendering and re-encoding.
